The viewer's page-range form (seqPaginaInicial/seqPaginaFinal) is regenerated by Aspose.PDF on every request with a new CreationDate and document /ID, so its SHA-256 changes from one generation to the next and it is not a reproducible identity. rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: In the joint solemn session of 1 January 2023 (14:55-16:04) Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva took the constitutional oath and the President of the National Congress (Rodrigo Pacheco) declared him empossado as President 'para o período de 1º de janeiro de 2023 a 4 de janeiro de 2027'; the Termo de Posse read into the record states that at 15:00 on 1 January 2023 he was solemnly given office.

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The ata and the Termo de Posse state that Lula was elected on 30 October 2022.

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The ata and the Termo de Posse state that Lula was certified (diplomado) by the Superior Electoral Court on 12 December 2022; the diplomas were handed to the Mesa for publication.

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The President of Congress opened the session to give office to the President and to the Vice-President of the Republic, 'Senhor Geraldo José Rodrigues Alckmin Filho', elected on 30 October 2022; the termo read into the record repeats the election day.

locator.section: opening declaration by Rodrigo Pacheco; termo on pdf p. 7

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: Invited as 'Vice-Presidente da República eleito', Geraldo José Rodrigues Alckmin Filho took the constitutional oath before Congress on 1 January 2023, after the President-elect.

locator.section: 'Convido o Excelentíssimo Vice-Presidente da República eleito ...' and 'O SR. GERALDO JOSÉ RODRIGUES ALCKMIN FILHO - Prometo ...'; signed termo de compromisso on pdf p. 26 (source br_cn_dcn1_20230102_p20_26)

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: After the oaths the President of Congress (Rodrigo Pacheco) declared Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Geraldo José Rodrigues Alckmin Filho 'empossados nos cargos de Presidente e Vice-Presidente da República Federativa do Brasil ... respectivamente, para o período de 1º de janeiro de 2023 a 4 de janeiro de 2027'. The session ran from 14:55 to 16:04.

locator.section: 'declaro empossados'; session times on pdf p. 5

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The First Secretary read the Termo de Posse: at 15:00 on 1 January 2023, before Congress in joint session in the Chamber's plenary, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Geraldo José Rodrigues Alckmin Filho were solemnly empossados under art. 78 of the Constitution as President and Vice-President, respectively, elected on 30 October 2022 and diplomados by the TSE on 12 December 2022, for the period 1 January 2023 to 4 January 2027; the President of Congress announced that the termo would be signed by the President, the Vice-President and the Mesa.

locator.section: 'Termo de posse do Excelentíssimo Senhor Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva e do Excelentíssimo Senhor Geraldo José Alckmin Filho' (read by Luciano Bivar)

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: In his address after the posse, President Lula saluted 'meu querido companheiro Vice-Presidente da República, Geraldo Alckmin'.

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-10 (rows with role_id br_president) and Vice-President observations for CLAUDE-C01-17 (rows with role_id br_vice_president). Election, diplomação, oath, posse, termo de posse, sash ceremony, authorization, summons, suspension, the Vice-President's exercise, the Vice-President's succession, resignation, vacancy, judgment, removal and disqualification stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. The Vice-President's exercise of the office recorded by CLAUDE-C01-10 stays on br_president rows; ministers and party offices are excluded.

source_review.remaining_gaps: The reviewer's 24,950,158-byte body was not kept and no copy exists on this machine, so which bytes differed cannot be shown, and its fetch time is not in the evidence. This service has returned damaged HTTP 200 bodies before: the CLAUDE-C01-17 verification received 19,397,271 bytes from this URL at 01:34:49 UTC on 25 September 2026 (SHA-256 2bc18af6e3758b2512d2afc3f813f7e2d450497d9ea94bf28192c810ec065977, not a prefix of the recorded file either) and the recorded identity six minutes later, and the CLAUDE-C01-10 and CLAUDE-C01-17 reports record other short Senate transfers. Origin responses are chunked with no Content-Length, so a damaged body cannot be recognised from the headers: a re-download that is not 24,950,218 bytes should be retried, or checked against the raw Internet Archive capture, which serves Content-Length 24950218. The Senate's verification service (sigadweb/v.aspx) was not queried and the QR codes were not decoded; only the printed verification code is recorded.
